<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 1 consists of two resistors in series between terminals A and X1, with one resistor twice the value of the other. Let the smaller resistor be R1; then the larger is R2 = 2·R1. The measured total resistance A‑X1 is 6.667 Ω, so R1 + R2 = 3·R1 = 6.667 Ω → R1 ≈ 2.222 Ω and R2 ≈ 4.444 Ω. The series connection can be represented with an intermediate node (e.g., N1). The required JSON describing this topology is provided below.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.444}, "connections": [["A", "N1", "R1"], ["N1", "X1", "R2"]]}</final_answer>
